revision: r4 (>=2-agree fill rule, ear shared cell, translucent cold-white glow overlay)

socialCanvasMinimum.reason: phone-front is 7 cells wide at x=17..23; the tap frames move it right by 1 cell to x=18..24

palette.note: The exact source phone crop already has 18 opaque colors, so a <=16 combined palette would alter visible source colors. Character and phone share one exact 18-color palette (alpha 0/255). The glow layers are translucent overlays: indexed PNG, 4-bit, 10 palette entries = transparent + 8 overlay alpha levels + the final eye-highlight alpha (dim H1=128, bright=255), represented in tRNS as required. No source color quantization.

phoneFront.maskRule: y8: x18,19,21,22; y9: x18..22; y10..19: x17..23 (79 cells). x=17 is the left bezel (r2); (18,8) is the shared left-ear/hair-outline cell (r3): present in BOTH char-back and phone-front

rowAlignment.awkward: dy=+1 for phone rows y=6..14, identity otherwise (braid rows 15..17 are identical either way)
rowAlignment.note: guard is evidence only in r3; the decision no longer uses it

effectPalette.rule: colour at x>=17 that is not in the phone pose visible braid/head palette (x=15,16 y=6..19 + x=13..17 y=0..9); verified absent from phone-pose visible cells x>=13

hairEvidence.rule: r3: for each phone-hidden cell, take the other three poses (row-aligned), drop effect colours; if >=2 poses give the SAME hair colour -> copy it into char-back. Exactly one colour vote => "single-vote" (kept only when no pose says empty, always listed separately). Nothing else is filled.

glow.design: r4 translucent overlay: cold-white colour, per-cell gradient alpha = peak * quantised raised-cosine falloff of the distance to the nose-bridge centre; dim and bright share the SAME gradient level map and differ only in peak alpha; H1 catch-light is dim alpha 128 / bright alpha 255; dark outline / dark iris cells are attenuated (x0.3 / x0.6), never cut out; cells under phone-front are not emitted

lightCentre.metric: d = sqrt(dx^2+dy^2) to the nearest centre cell: dx = 10-x (x<=10) | x-11 (x>=11), dy = y-14

formula.falloff: f(d) = 0.5*(1+cos(pi*d/R)) for d<R, else 0 (raised cosine; 1 at the centre, 0 with zero slope at the edge)
formula.levelRule: level = round(8 * f(d) * k(class)), k(class) = 0.3 for #7b5f80 outlines and #6673aa dark iris, 0.6 for #87a5d9 mid iris, 1 otherwise
formula.blend: out = base*(1-a) + overlay*a  (straight sRGB alpha, as a browser composites)

glow.colorReason: overlay #eef6ff = hue 210 deg, HSV saturation 6.7 %: inside the requested #eef6ff..#f4faff window and on the cool side of neutral (no pink/warm component at all), so on the pale-pink skin it removes chroma toward blue-white rather than replacing the cell. One colour for all levels: the alpha ladder alone carries the falloff. Highlight #f8fcff (hue 205 deg, S 2.8 %) is a touch whiter than the overlay; selected H1 dims it to alpha 128 and keeps bright at 255.

highlight.rule: upper-right cell of each 2x3 iris block (same relative cell in both eyes: one light source on the phone side, the same side of both irises); selected H1 is present in both layers with dim alpha 128 and bright alpha 255

legacyR3.note: r3 discrete pink-white replacement layers kept only for the old/new comparison preview

c2.label: medium
c2.falloff: core: raised cosine of d/coreRadius (1 at d=0, 0 at d=coreRadius); halo: haloTop * (1-(d/haloRadius)^haloPower) for d<haloRadius, else 0; g(d) = max(core, halo); level = round(levels*g(d)*k(class)); alpha8 = round(peakAlpha*level/levels)

haloRing.approach: mean alpha of the class-1 cells with coreRadius <= d <= coreRadius+2 (the band just outside the core)

colourMath.unreachableNote: A cold-white overlay cannot reach dE76 11..16 on #ffebfa: blending #ffebfa (L* 94.98, a* +9.32) with any in-spec cold white tops out at dE76 = dE76(#ffebfa, overlay) < 11.2 even at alpha 255, and r4 already caps the bright peak at dE76 <= 8 to avoid the r3 white-mask look. The perceptible signal is the dim->bright step, reported above as dE76DimToBright.

adoptionBytes.note: base64 length of the four data-URI payloads (not the full CSS declaration text) for the set that would ship if this candidate replaced glow-dim/glow-bright; c1 is 420 + 244 + 284 + 284 = 1232

glow.strengthCandidateSearch: Candidates were chosen by sweeping coreRadius / haloTop / haloTop power / haloRadius / levels against the real CSS composite crop (24x21 canvas cells at W320 DPR1) so that the dim->bright mean absolute channel delta rises as far as the "cold white, soft edge, no mask" constraints allow. See runtime/checks/r10-phone-layers/README.md for the sweep and the ceiling argument.
